name: kirocrew-acp-adapters
description: The exact version of each ACP adapter Kiro Crew installs with `npm install -g <name>@<version>`: claude-agent-acp from the installers (install.sh, setup.sh, minimal_install.sh), muse-acp from the Muse backend's install command. Read through scripts/lib/acp-adapter-pin.sh; nothing here is installed from this directory. Exact versions only: a range or `latest` would let an install pick up a release published minutes earlier. Dependabot proposes a bump weekly, after a 7-day cooldown. To bump by hand: edit the exact version, keep claude-agent-acp at or above CLAUDE_ACP_SETTING_SOURCES_MIN_VERSION in src/kiro_crew/acp/client_claude_session.py and muse-acp equal to MUSE_ACP_VERSION in src/kiro_crew/acp/harness/muse.py, and run test/test_installer_pins.py.
